model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата показва графика на съотношението на разреденост на изхода на SDPA при праг от 1e-2. Графиките илюстрират промените в съотношението на разреденост преди и след прилагането на гейтове.

Оста X е обозначена като "Слой" и има линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до 22, без посочени мерни единици. Етикетите са разположени на интервали от 5, със стойности 0, 5, 10 и т.н. до 20.

Оста Y е обозначена като "Съотношение на разреденост" и също има линейна скала с диапазон от 0,0 до 1,0. Няма посочени мерни единици за оста Y.

Графиката съдържа три линии:
- Първата линия е синя, пунктирана и представя съотношението на разреденост преди гейт, със средно стойност от 0.03. Тя започва около 0.15 при слой 0 и намалява до под 0.05 при слой 5, след което остава почти постоянна до слой 20.
- Втората линия е оранжева, пунктирана и показва съотношението на разреденост след гейт, със средно стойност от 0.44. Тя започва близо до 0.95 при слой 0 и намалява до около 0.25 при слой 20.
- Третата линия е зелена и пунктирана и илюстрира съотношението на разреденост след средния гейт, със средно стойност от 0.33. Тя започва близо до 0.95 при слой 0 и намалява до около 0.25 при слой 20.

Ясно видими са началните високи стойности на съотношението на разреденост и тенденцията за намаляние с увеличаването на номера на слоя за всички три линии. Няма забележителни върхове или спадове освен общата тенденция на намаляние.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The line graph displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output with a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers. 

The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to 23, with a linear scale and no units specified, and numerical tick marks at intervals of 5. 

The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with a linear scale and no units specified, and numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.2.

The graph contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate with an average of 0.03, an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate with an average of 0.44, and a green line with a solid and dotted section representing the sparsity ratio after average gate with an average of 0.33. The blue line starts at approximately (0, 0.15) and decreases to approximately (23, 0.005). The orange line starts at approximately (0, 0.95) and decreases to approximately (3, 0.7) then fluctuates, ending at approximately (23, 0.4). The green line starts at approximately (0, 0.95) and decreases to approximately (23, 0.25).
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates how sparsity ratio changes across layers under different conditions. The x-axis represents Layer, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, and tick labels at every integer interval. The y-axis represents Sparsity Ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and tick labels at every 0.2 interval. There are three lines in the plot: a blue dashed line representing sparsity ratio before gate, an orange dotted line representing sparsity ratio after gate, and a green solid line representing sparsity ratio after average gate. The blue line starts at approximately 0.15 and decreases to around 0.01, with a steady decline across layers 0 to 5, then remaining relatively stable. The orange line starts at about 0.95 and decreases to around 0.30, with a decline from layers 0 to 10, then fluctuating between 0.30 and 0.40. The green line starts at approximately 0.95 and decreases to around 0.20, with a decline from layers 0 to 15, then stabilizing around 0.20.
model_annotations.German:
The diagram illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output with a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers. The x-axis represents the layer, with values ranging from 0 to 23, and is labeled as "Layer" with no units provided. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, with values ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and is labeled as "Sparsity Ratio". 

The diagram displays three lines: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate with an average of 0.03, an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate with an average of 0.44, and a green line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate with an average of 0.33. 

The blue line starts at approximately 0.15 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.01 at layer 5, remaining relatively stable with minor fluctuations at 0.01 from layer 5 to layer 23. The orange line starts at approximately 0.95 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.25 at layer 5, then fluctuates between 0.25 and 0.45 from layer 5 to layer 23, with values of 0.35 at layer 10, 0.35 at layer 15, 0.3 at layer 20, and 0.4 at layer 23. The green line starts at 0.95 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.8 at layer 1, 0.55 at layer 5, and 0.25 at layer 10, and remains relatively stable at 0.25 from layer 10 to layer 23, with values of 0.25 at layer 15 and 0.25 at layer 20.
